name: Two Sides of the Same Coin
source:
In the seemingly tranquil town of Sumairu-Urbem, you are a teacher embedded in the web of a corrupted school. A sudden twist of fate via a jarring accident thrusts you into the world of partial amnesia. As fragments of your past elude you, a cryptic relative is your only guide, though she holds her cards close to her chest.

[From [url=https://dajimess.itch.io/two-sides-of-the-same-coin-nsfw]itch.io[/url]]
